```sql
SELECT SUM(bl.quantity) as total_units_sold
FROM store.bill_lines bl
JOIN store.products p ON bl.scanned_gtin = p.has_gtin
WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
  AND bl.bill_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND bl.bill_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bl.bill_id) as shoppers_without_atta
FROM store.bill_lines bl
JOIN store.products p ON bl.scanned_gtin = p.has_gtin
WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
  AND bl.bill_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND bl.bill_timestamp < '2026-07-01'
  AND bl.quantity = 0;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN sa.shelf_status = 'on shelf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as on_shelf_availability
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.of_product = p.sku
WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
  AND sa.audit_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND sa.audit_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(ds.units_sold), 0) as total_demand,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.shelf_status = 'empty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as out_of_stock_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.shelf_status = 'empty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_timestamp) as lost_sales_ratio
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.of_product = p.sku
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits sa ON sa.of_product = p.sku 
  AND sa.audit_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND sa.audit_timestamp < '2026-07-01'
WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
GROUP BY ds.of_product;
```
